note: Rustic campground on Connors Lake, with a boat landing, a designated swimming area reached by a foot path and a 0.3-mile nature trail. ATVs and UTVs may not be driven in the campground and must stay trailered. --Claude
summary: Flambeau River SF camping page and the DNR brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 29 sites, 4 electric (7, 9, 10, 11; amperage not stated), vault toilets, hand pump, all reservable, May-October confirmed. Lakeview kept but weak (sites unplaceable under canopy). Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept, but weakly supported (no --AWH). The brochure map puts the lake on the west side, with the swimming beach reached by a foot path from the 17-18 end; the nearest sites to the water are the west-loop sites 10E, 11E, 13, 15 and 17. On Esri and USGS imagery the whole campground is under continuous hardwood/conifer canopy, the stored pin is about 125 m from the south shore, and no pad can be placed. Nothing supports an upgrade; if the reviewer wants a firmer call, the GoingToCamp site photos for 10E-17 are the source (refuses to me).

HOOKUPS: 4 electric sites (7, 9, 10, 11) per the DNR; amperage is not stated anywhere I could read, so hookups.electric stays unset. The stored $34 high is presumably those sites (GoingToCamp, unread).
